name: Bear Packaging & Supply Inc
old_description: Founded in warren michigan in 1967, bear packaging & supply (formerly the bland company) has been manufacturing high quality plastic bags under the trade mark “bear claw bags” for some 45 years. In the early 80’s manufacturing was moved to a more centralized location in mt. Pleasant, to better serve the needs of customers in central and northern michigan. In 1994 all operations were consolidated into the mt pleasant location, and remain there today. 2002 saw the first change in ownership when bear packaging & supply was purchased by triple threat inc. Bear claw bags have become known throughout michigan as the highest quality bags in the market. It always has and always will be the promise that bear claw bags are made up to a quality standard, not down to a price. Quality, service and value remain our guiding principle to our customers.
about:
Bear Packaging & Supply Inc began in 1967 in Warren, Michigan, as the Bland Company. The business adopted the Bear Claw Bags trademark and relocated manufacturing to Mt. Pleasant in the early 1980s to serve central and northern Michigan. All operations consolidated in Mt. Pleasant by 1994. In 2002, Triple Threat Inc acquired the company, which continues to operate from its Mt. Pleasant facility.

The company produces plastic bags including trash bags (16, 30, and 55 gallon), animal feed bags, and custom table covers in multiple colors and sizes. With four converting lines and large material inventory on hand, Bear Packaging can produce custom-sized bags within one to two business days with low minimum orders. Bags are made to a 2-mil thick, super heavy-duty standard.

The company serves customers across Michigan, supplying waste management firms, agricultural operations needing feed bags, and event planners requiring custom table coverings for parties and weddings.

Bear Packaging emphasizes manufacturing to a quality standard rather than a price point, with guiding principles of quality, service, and value. The company highlights quick turnaround on custom orders and low minimums as key differentiators.
